library.title: Library
library.emptyHint: Ask ChatGPT or Claude to turn your notes or past exam questions into a quiz. Tap Import, then “Copy prompt for ChatGPT/Claude” to get the exact instructions.
library.discardConfirm: Discard your unfinished quiz? Its answers will be lost.
library.deleteFolderConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Its subfolders and quizzes are removed too. Your history is kept.
library.activeSessionConfirm: This is part of your unfinished quiz. Delete it anyway and discard that progress?

start.title: Start
start.practiceHint: See the answer and explanation right after each question.
start.examHint: Answers are revealed only after you submit. A stopwatch runs.
start.shuffleOptionsHint: Off by default: options like “A and B” depend on their order.
start.noQuestions: There are no questions here yet.

import.title: Import quiz
import.promptCopied: Prompt copied. Paste it into ChatGPT or Claude together with your notes or PDF.
import.fileTooLarge: This file is too big to import (limit 10 MB).
import.fileReadError: The file could not be read.
import.duplicateBody: “{title}” with the same questions is already in your library. Import again anyway?

issue.empty: Nothing to import. Paste the quiz JSON first.
issue.too_large: This is too big to import (limit {maxMb} MB).
issue.not_utf8: This file isn't UTF-8 text. Save it as UTF-8 and try again.
issue.wrong_shape: This doesn't look like a Quizkit quiz. It must be one JSON object with "title" and "questions".
issue.syntax: The JSON has a mistake at line {line}, column {column}.
issue.schema_version_unsupported: This quiz uses format version {found}. This app reads version 1: set "schemaVersion": 1, or update the app.
issue.title_invalid: The quiz needs a "title" of 1–{max} characters.
issue.answer_invalid: Question {question}: "answer" must be a letter A–F (found "{answer}").
issue.answer_out_of_range: Question {question}: the answer is “{answer}” but there are only {optionCount} options.
issue.duplicate_id: Question {question}: the id “{id}” is used twice.

hint.trailing_comma: There is an extra comma before a closing bracket.
hint.missing_quote: A quotation mark seems to be missing.
hint.truncated: The text ends too early. The AI probably stopped mid-answer: ask it to continue, or to send the whole JSON again.
hint.unknown: Check the JSON around this spot.

warning.odd_dollar: Question {question}: a $ in the {field} has no partner, so it is shown as plain text.
warning.math_unparseable: Question {question}: a formula in the {field} can't be displayed: {snippet}
warning.images_unsupported: {count} questions had images. Images aren't supported yet and were left out.
warning.backslashes_repaired: We fixed {count} LaTeX backslashes the AI forgot to double.

session.leaveBody: Your progress is saved. You can resume from the library.
session.submitUnanswered: {n} questions are unanswered and will count as wrong.
session.submitUnanswered_one: {n} question is unanswered and will count as wrong.
session.cannotResume: This quiz could not be resumed because its questions were deleted.

results.title: Results
results.notFound: This result could not be found.

settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteAllConfirm: Delete every folder, quiz and result on this device? This cannot be undone.
settings.about: Quizkit works fully offline. Nothing you import or answer leaves this device.

app.loadError: Quizkit could not open its data.
app.resetConfirm: This deletes all quizzes and results on this device. Continue?

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.body: Your quizzes and progress are saved.
